verdicts.answer: Broadcom: filed an 8-K (a current-events report) under Item 2.03, which means it took on a new direct financial obligation such as debt. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526434271/d148323d8k.htm

verdicts.note: It misdescribes Item 2.03 as a material agreement or financial results, which is wrong, and adds a filler line about no price move.
verdicts.answer: Broadcom filed an 8-K today (item 2.03 — material agreement or financial results): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526434271/d148323d8k.htm. No price move recorded for Broadcom today.

verdicts.note: Good explanation, though 'i.e. new debt' slightly overstates it, since Item 2.03 can also cover off-balance-sheet obligations.
verdicts.answer: Broadcom: filed an 8-K (current-events report, item 2.03) — it has taken on a new direct financial obligation, i.e. new debt. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1730168/000119312526434271/d148323d8k.htm
